channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Luc Mbah a Moute | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Luc Mbah a Moute from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Luc Mbah a Moute
item.description:
Alykhan Bijani:Coach D'Antoni on James Harden, Russell Westbrook and Luc Mbah A Moute getting to Orlando:

“It'll be soon. Not gonna be long, we hope. We think we'll get em back in here towards the middle of the week.”

Mike D'Antoni on James Harden, Russell Westbrook, Luc Mbah a Moute, Jul 13, 2020. Source: Twitter @Rockets_Insider.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Luc Mbah a Moute
item.description:
Rockets coachMike D'Antoni on Luc Mbah a Moute, who has struggled since returning from dislocating his right shoulder for the second time this season:

“I'll stick with him and trust him because he deserves that. He's one of the reasons why we're here and we won 65 games.”

Mike D'Antoni on Luc Mbah a Moute, May 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Luc Mbah a Moute
item.description:
Mike D'Antoni on Luc Mbah a Moute not ruling out a potential return in the first round:

“I don't think we're close enough to be able to say yeah he can come back this round, next round. We don't know yet... It's not too far down the road.”

Mike D'Antoni on Luc Mbah a Moute, Apr 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.
